significance: A major Mangalore temple that grew out of the Buddhist Kadarika Vihara, keeping a metre-and-a-half bronze Lokeshwara installed by the Alupa king Kundavarma and dated by inscription to 968; the shrine was rebuilt entirely in stone in the 14th century and carries inscriptions in Tulu, Kannada and Malayalam.
story: Parashurama is said to have done penance at Kadali Kshetra, where Shiva appeared to him as Manjunatha with Parvati.
